primary_article_evidence.source: Cached full-text JATS Results section and RNA-sequencing methods
primary_article_evidence.finding: Male tagged-allele animals show mid-pachytene arrest; P19 testes used for RNA-seq. This is a source-reported model phenotype, not independent phenotyping of deposited samples.
primary_article_evidence.control_note: GEO labels control; manuscript uses WT comparator. No individual animal or batch crosswalk established.

primary_article_evidence.source: Cached publisher JATS, Fig 6 and ribosome profiling methods
primary_article_evidence.finding: P16 total RNA taken alongside ribosome profiling; Mael+/- and Mael-/- testes described as comparable tissue complexity. Do not equate this sampled context with established arrest.
primary_article_evidence.repeat_note: Only 20620 rows lacking all repeat annotations are treated as gene features; repeat loci excluded.

primary_article_evidence.source: GEO GSM1547662-GSM1547667 processing and extraction; cached article JATS
primary_article_evidence.finding: P14.5 whole-testis HET/tg mutants, one mouse per library per GEO. Source states germ cells fail meiotic pairing. Counts from seventh column, never eighth RPKM. GEO KO retained as source alias; article uses tg allele.
primary_article_evidence.erratum_status: Full-text erratum reviewed: production switched Fig2f and Fig2g bars. No figure values used here; this analysis extracts the deposited raw-read columns.

unresolved.finding: GEO citation missing; bounded search did not locate linked primary publication. P14 from series design; sKO/Cre allele details and matrix-to-library-name crosswalk unresolved.
unresolved.mapping: Matrix con/scKO columns align with GEO WT/sKO group counts and suffixes; tentative aliases only. Fits and omissions use native matrix labels.

limitations: Each Morc1 library is one mouse according to GEO extraction; distinct animals across all libraries, pooling/litter/batch structures and source-specific phenotypes remain not independently certified.
No source independently certifies batch, litter pairing or pooling identities for all samples.
Three contexts selected using metadata/schema before differential-expression inspection; targeted search is incomplete.
No primary replication family expansion or biological validation.
